articles.title: “重走长征路”上热搜 “长征游”圈粉年轻人
articles.highlight: 他们是土生土长的吴起人，想利用假期更好了解长征历史，“把家乡的红色故事讲给更多朋友”。
articles.summary: 文章以国庆假期“重走长征路”上热搜、“长征游”圈粉年轻人为背景，写到陕西吴起县中央红军长征胜利纪念馆里，两名土生土长的当地中学生带着问题清单参观并想更好了解长征历史。它值得读，是因为这一细节呈现了红色旅游在年轻人中的吸引力，也提示地方红色故事需要用青年愿意参与的方式被讲述和传播。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点在于，红色旅游若想持续打动年轻人，需要把历史内容与在地体验、青年表达和真实问题意识结合起来；学生主动列问题清单参观，说明参与感往往比单向宣讲更能建立连接。

It highlights two local students from Wuqi, Shaanxi, visiting the Central Red Army Long March Victory Memorial Hall with question lists to learn more about Long March history. articles.title: S P A C E S
articles.highlight: 一位电影创作者试图重建她哥哥对时间摇摇欲坠的体验：漂泊无依，缺乏连续性。
articles.summary: 这是 Psyche 上的一段视频，由 Nora Štrbová 执导。它跟随一位电影创作者，尝试重建她哥哥的时间感如何变得漂泊、失去连续性，并触及“记得过去却遗忘当下”是什么感觉。它值得看，因为它用影像方式让人接近难以言说的时间体验与自我连续性问题。

en.highlight: A filmmaker tries to reconstruct her brother’s faltering experience of time: adrift and without continuity.
en.summary: This is a Psyche video directed by Nora Štrbová. It follows a filmmaker trying to reconstruct her brother’s faltering experience of time, which is adrift and without continuity, and it touches on what it is like to remember your past but forget your present. It is worth watching for a cinematic way to approach an elusive experience of time and self-continuity.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that temporal continuity and a sense of the present are not things we can take for granted, and film can help outsiders grasp this experience.

articles.title: HarnessRouter/harnessrouter
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这个 GitHub 仓库（2884 stars）提供 HarnessRouter 社区版，是 Apache-2.0 许可的自托管统一接口，让 Codex、Claude Code、Hermes、PI、DSH 等智能体执行环境通过一个 API 调用，并处理会话、流式输出、文件、取消和故障。它实现开放标准 Unified Harness Protocol（UHP），强调用户自带密钥和自有基础设施。对非技术管理者而言，它值得关注是因为切中了多智能体工具碎片化与企业自托管需求，但项目仍处于协议和生态验证阶段。
articles.failureAnalysis: 该项目的核心风险在于抽象层需要持续跟进 Codex、Claude Code 等快速变化的执行环境，维护和兼容成本可能很高；一旦官方接口或行为变动，统一 API 很容易失效或被迫追赶。自托管虽然满足数据与合规诉求，但会带来部署、升级、安全和运维负担，可能把部分用户推向托管方案。UHP 作为开放标准还面临采用不足的鸡生蛋难题，若生态伙伴不跟进，统一接口的价值会被削弱。其商业模式也不清晰：Apache-2.0 社区版如何转化为收入、企业是否愿意为集成与支持付费，仍需验证。
articles.highlight: 通过一个 API 运行 Codex、Claude Code、Hermes、PI、DSH 等智能体执行环境，并支持会话、流式、文件、取消与故障处理。

en.highlight: Run Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, PI, DSH, and more through one API, with sessions, streaming, files, cancellation, and failure handling.
en.summary: This GitHub repository offers HarnessRouter Community Edition, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted unified interface that lets Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, PI, DSH, and other agent harnesses run through one API, with sessions, streaming, files, cancellation, and failure handling. It implements the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP), an open standard, and emphasizes bring-your-own keys and infrastructure. It is worth reading because it targets the fragmentation of agent tooling and enterprise self-hosting needs, though its protocol and ecosystem remain unproven.
en.failureAnalysis: The main risk is that a unified abstraction must keep pace with fast-changing agent harnesses, so maintenance and compatibility costs may be high. Self-hosting adds deployment, upgrade, security, and operations burdens, and the open UHP standard faces a chicken-and-egg adoption problem with an unclear business model.
en.title: HarnessRouter: A Self-Hosted Unified Interface for Agent Harnesses
